name: CAIO Run & Optimize
description: Phase-5 RUN step of the Chief AI Officer On Demand accompaniment chain. Once the Company AI OS is live and the team autonomous, this skill RUNS it: measures ACTUAL post-go-live ROI from real telemetry and receipts (never invented), in cohorts, against the architect's projected ROI (09-ROI) — proving or falsifying it (the offer's re-measure test); specs the monitoring/health dashboard (liveness, cost, usage, quality, value) with alert thresholds that turn a reactive company into a piloted one; runs the weekly/monthly optimization loop that re-scores the architect backlog against measured data and finds the next-highest-value improvement; operates the deliberately-light 1h/week strategic quota (mm-08 — price = positioning, the lightness is intentional; overage is a scoped mini-SOW); and drives retention + land-and-expand to the next department (mm-08 NRR + mm-09 internal-reference network effect). Closes the chain into a compounding loop back to caio-enterprise-workflow-architect for the next wave. Does NOT train (enablement) or build (implementation); delegates public case studies to creator-media-engine with consent. Reads caio-enablement/ (06-Ownership-Handover-Checklist + 08-Adoption-Tracker + 04-Validated-Use-Cases-Log) + 09-ROI + 05-backlog + caio-build/07-Monitoring-And-Instrumentation.md (§5.8). Writes caio-run/ with 7 deliverables.
